newsitem.title: USA: Claire's Stores sees record qtly earnings.
newsitem.headline: Claire's Stores sees record qtly earnings.

text.p: Claire's Stores Inc said Thursday it had record third quarter, ended November 2, sales and expects earnings also to be at a record level.
"Obviously we have had a very good third quarter," said Chairman Rowland Schaefer.
The company will release third quarter earnings figures November 12, he added.
"We expect the fourth quarter also to set new records in sales and earnings and for that momentum to continue into the first quarter of Fiscal 1998."
Schaefer also noted the company's inventory levels are in line with plans and that inventory turns are at a 3.0 times per year rate.
"We're also planning to open another 200 new stores next year and we're actively looking for appropriate acquisition targets," he said.
Claire's Stores owns and operates 1542 stores in 49 states, the Caribbean, Canada, Japan and the United Kingdom.
